name: @pipeworx/mcp-openalex

tools.name: search_works
tools.description: Search scholarly/academic research across ALL fields — medicine, biology, neuroscience, genetics, chemistry, physics, materials science, computer science, economics, and beyond. Find recent studies, papers, and findings on any topic, gene, disease, drug, material, method, or theory by title, author, or keyword — e.g. "latest research on Kv7 potassium channels in epilepsy", "recent studies on semaglutide", "what has been published on X". Returns title, authors, journal, publication year, citation count, and abstract.

_apiKey.description: OpenAlex API key. Optional — Pipeworx supplies one; pass your own to bill your account instead.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-25, default 10)

tools.name: search_authors
tools.description: Find researchers by name or institution affiliation. Returns author name, ORCID, institution, publication count, and total citations.

query.description: Author name to search for (e.g., "Yoshua Bengio")

_apiKey.description: OpenAlex API key. Optional — Pipeworx supplies one; pass your own to bill your account instead.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-25, default 10)

tools.name: search_institutions
tools.description: Find academic institutions by name or location (e.g., country code 'US', 'GB'). Returns institution name, country, type, publication count, and research areas.

_apiKey.description: OpenAlex API key. Optional — Pipeworx supplies one; pass your own to bill your account instead.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-25, default 10)

tools.name: get_concept
tools.description: Look up research fields or topics by name. Returns concept description, publication count, related concepts, and parent concepts in the academic hierarchy.

query.description: Concept name to look up (e.g., "deep learning")

_apiKey.description: OpenAlex API key. Optional — Pipeworx supplies one; pass your own to bill your account instead.

tools.name: get_scholarly_work
tools.description: Fetch a single scholarly work from OpenAlex by its OpenAlex ID (e.g. "W2741809807") or DOI (e.g. "10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2"). Returns the full record + reconstructed abstract and the works it CITES (referenced_works) — for backward citation-graph navigation. Use after search_works, or whenever you have a DOI/ID. (Named get_scholarly_work to avoid colliding with Crossref get_work.)

id.description: OpenAlex work ID ("W...") or a DOI ("10.xxxx/yyyy" or a full doi.org URL).

_apiKey.description: OpenAlex API key. Optional — Pipeworx supplies one; pass your own to bill your account instead.

tools.name: get_journal_publishing_model
tools.description: Is a journal subscription, hybrid or fully open access? Look up a journal by ISSN (print or electronic, e.g. "0025-1461" or "1864-1547") and get its publisher, article-processing charge, whether the Directory of Open Access Journals lists it, and the open-access status mix of its recent articles (gold, diamond, hybrid, bronze, green, closed), with a derived model label: open_access, hybrid or subscription. The label is inferred from article-level evidence, not declared by the publisher.

issn.description: Journal ISSN, print or electronic, e.g. "1864-1547"

years.description: Look-back window in years for the article mix (1-15, default 5)

_apiKey.description: OpenAlex API key. Optional — Pipeworx supplies one; pass your own to bill your account instead.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-openalex forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the openalex pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
